asr_text: After an hour, the island and the conversation go back to the beginning. The buildings and everything said just moments ago are reset. It is a pretty tough world, but there is one way around it. Notes that have been written down can be carried into the next hour. An AI experiment on an island inside a computer showed how much these strategy notes can matter. The AI systems sent to the island had no specific tasks or rewards, But, their initial settings guided them to be curious, explore, and learn. They had no homework, but they were in exploration mode. Then, one AI started an obstacle course of its own. It surrounded a building called the Cathedral with eight blocks, and jumped across without touching the ground. It designed the course and made the rules all by itself. It was keeping pretty busy, even though nobody had asked it to. The researchers say this shows a feature of play.
